The '''Brite-Boyz''' were a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of the [[Bright Star (mercenary company)|Bright Star]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] company. They wore chrome-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]].
